adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, the diff sets `usernames = params.require(:usernames)` and then unconditionally calls `usernames.split(",")` and iterates, doing `User.find_by_username` + `group.add` per entry. If the client sends `usernames` as an array (e.g., `usernames[]=a&usernames[]=b`), `split` will raise `NoMethodError`, producing a 500. The per-entry loop is also unbounded within a single request, enabling excessive DB lookups and membership adds.
